_comment: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only variable assignments and dictionary literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines hyperparameters, model architecture, optimizer, data pipelines, and dataset settings for training a Sapiens 1B vision transformer for semantic segmentation on the Goliath dataset at 1024x768 resolution.
review_CONFIG: review the MMSegmentation config for Sapiens 1B segmentation model training on Goliath dataset
summarize_CONFIG: summarize the Sapiens 1B segmentation model configuration including backbone, optimizer, and dataset settings
refactor_CONFIG: refactor the Sapiens 1B segmentation config to change image resolution or number of classes
build_CONFIG: build a new segmentation training config based on the Sapiens 1B Goliath template
test_CONFIG: test the Sapiens 1B segmentation config by validating model architecture and data pipeline settings
